projectExperiences.projectName: 360° Panoramic Cloud Platform AI Document Processing Backend

Multi-engine AI document processing pipeline: PDF electronic/scan dual-mode parsing, 3-stage intelligent document classification (L1 keyword→L2 OCR→L3 AI semantic), Redis-based async task queue, handling hundreds of thousands of daily requests.
